metadata.notes: Cleaned: removed 3 inorganics/prodrugs, fixed 3 extraction artifacts Added 36 drugs from OpenFDA (2026-03-20).

acetaminophen.source_id: PK-DB: Prescott1993 (PMID:9114910) via reference_database. Curve Cmax=15.18 mg/L at 1000mg oral.
acetaminophen.notes: Reference_database dose_mg field shows 20mg (likely unit error — concentrations are physiological for 1000mg). Cmax=15.18 consistent with literature 10-25 mg/L for 1000mg oral acetaminophen.

amoxicillin.source_id: FDA label (Amoxil NDA 050821): 500mg oral capsule single dose fasted, Cmax≈7.5 µg/mL at 2h.
amoxicillin.notes: Exact benchmark dose. Synthetic reference was 9.52 mg/L (27% too high). FDA label 7.5 µg/mL well-established for amoxicillin 500mg capsule.

atenolol.source_id: FDA label (Tenormin NDA 018240): 50mg oral single dose, Cmax approximately 300 ng/mL at 2-4h.
atenolol.notes: Exact benchmark dose. Synthetic reference was 0.38 mg/L (27% too high). Atenolol has linear PK.

atorvastatin.source_id: FDA label NDA 020702 Lipitor 40mg oral; Table 1: Cmax 5.3 ng/mL = 0.0053 mg/L
atorvastatin.notes: Parent atorvastatin acid only (not total including metabolites). FDA Lipitor label exact.

caffeine.source_id: PK-DB: Edwards2017, 200mg oral, n=24, healthy volunteers. Dose-normalized: x0.5 (100/200mg). Cmax=5.207 at 200mg x0.5=2.6035.
caffeine.notes: CORRECTED 2026-03-18: Wahllaender1990 was a LIVER DISEASE patient study (impaired CYP1A2 clearance → elevated Cmax=9.55 mg/L at 200mg → dose-norm 4.78). Replaced with Edwards2017 (healthy volunteers, DDI study context, n=24, 200mg, Cmax=5.207 → dose-norm 2.60). Caffeine PK is linear in 50-400mg range. Consistent with literature: typical 100mg Cmax 1.5-3 mg/L in healthy adults.

carbamazepine.source_id: FDA label Tegretol 200mg single dose; Levy 1975 Neurology, Eichelbaum 1975; range 0.7-1.6 mg/L
carbamazepine.notes: Single dose only (before autoinduction). Slow absorption: tmax 4-8h.

d_amphetamine.source_id: FDA label Adderall (mixed amphetamine salts) dose-proportional; 10mg -> ~29 ng/mL, 20mg -> ~58 ng/mL. PMID:12818571
d_amphetamine.notes: d-amphetamine component of Adderall. Linear PK at this dose range.

diazepam.source_id: FDA label Valium 10mg oral; Klotz 1975 J Pharmacol Exp Ther (0.35 mg/L); Reidenberg 1972 (0.30-0.50 mg/L)
diazepam.notes: Fasted oral administration. High variability but consistently ~0.30-0.40 mg/L for 10mg.

digoxin.source_id: FDA label NDA 009460 Lanoxin 0.5mg oral tablet; PK Table: Cmax 1.5 ng/mL = 0.0015 mg/L
digoxin.notes: Tablet formulation. Confirmed by multiple studies.

fluoxetine.source_id: FDA label NDA 018936 Prozac 20mg single dose; range 15-55 ng/mL, typical ~20 ng/mL. Lemberger 1985
fluoxetine.notes: Parent fluoxetine only (not norfluoxetine). Single dose. High variability (CV~40%).

furosemide.source_id: Mehanna et al. (2003) Biopharm Drug Dispos 24(8):343-350 (PMID 12973821). Healthy volunteers n=24, fasted, single 40mg oral Lasix tablet. Cmax=1109.71 ng/mL for reference (Lasix) brand.
furosemide.notes: Synthetic reference was 2.0 mg/L (80% too high). Multiple bioequivalence studies confirm 1.1-1.6 mg/L range for 40mg oral fasted. Using Lasix reference arm (n=24). Walsh 2014 study: 1315-1584 ng/mL. Model predicts 0.77 mg/L: still under-predicts 1.4x but accurate relative to synthetic 2.6x error.

gabapentin.source_id: FDA label NDA 021435 Neurontin 300mg single dose; Table 1: Cmax = 2.99 microg/mL = 2.99 mg/L
gabapentin.notes: Saturable absorption (decreasing bioavailability at higher doses). 300mg: F~60%.

ibuprofen.source_id: FDA label (NDA 019842): 400mg single oral dose fasted

metformin.source_id: FDA label (Glucophage NDA 021202): 500mg single oral dose fasted, Cmax=1.03 µg/mL at 2.5h.
metformin.notes: Exact benchmark dose (500mg metformin HCl). Synthetic reference was 1.35 mg/L (31% too high). Standard FDA PK study value.

metoprolol.source_id: FDA label NDA 019962 Lopressor 100mg IR oral; median across studies 50-120 ng/mL
metoprolol.notes: High inter-individual variability (~50% CV). Median ~65 ng/mL.

midazolam.source_id: PK-DB: Gorski2003 (PMID:12966371), 2.5mg oral, n=52. Dose-normalized: x0.8 (2.0/2.5mg). Linear PK assumption validated.
midazolam.notes: Cmax=0.03435 at 2.5mg x0.8=0.02748. Midazolam PK is linear in 1-5mg range.

nifedipine.source_id: FDA label NDA 018276 Procardia 10mg IR capsule fasted; mean Cmax 69 ng/mL = 0.069 mg/L
nifedipine.notes: Immediate-release capsule only (NOT XL). Fasted. Half-life ~2h.

omeprazole.source_id: PK-DB: Elkoshi2002 (PMID:29492852), 40mg oral, n=40. Dose-normalized: x0.5 (20/40mg). Non-linear PK caution.
omeprazole.notes: Omeprazole has dose-dependent PK due to CYP2C19 autoinhibition. First-dose normalization may underestimate 20mg Cmax. Use with lower confidence. Consistent with reference_database curve_cmax=0.282 at 40mg x0.5.

phenytoin.source_id: FDA label Dilantin 300mg sodium (=276mg free acid); Yukawa 1993 J Clin Pharmacol; range 4-6 mg/L
phenytoin.notes: Single dose. Saturable absorption at higher doses. tmax highly variable (4-12h).

propranolol.source_id: FDA label NDA 016418 Inderal 80mg oral IR; Shand 1970 Clin Pharmacol Ther, range 30-200 ng/mL
propranolol.notes: Extreme first-pass variability (~70% CV). Median ~80 ng/mL for 80mg oral fasted.

theophylline.source_id: PK-DB: Becker1984 (PMID:6700656), 250mg oral. Dose-normalized: x1.2 (300/250mg). Consistent with reference_database pk_cmax=14.5 at unknown dose.
theophylline.notes: Theophylline PK is linear at therapeutic doses. Consistent with FDA label range 10-20mcg/mL.

verapamil.source_id: PK-DB: Rebello2011 (PMID:20413453) via reference_database pk_params.cmax_mg_L=0.077. Exact benchmark dose.
verapamil.notes: pk_cmax=0.077 consistent with literature 50-100 ng/mL for 80mg oral verapamil IR. Note: reference_database ct_curve_cmax=0.199 appears incorrect (likely different study arm or unit issue); using pk_cmax directly.

warfarin.source_id: PK-DB: Baekdal2019 (PMID:30945118), 10mg oral, n=52. Already in benchmark CSV.

alosetron.notes: Fixed: dose was 4mg (2x BID total). Cmax=5 ng/mL matches 1mg single dose from FDA label.

carglumic acid.notes: WARNING: dose may be mg/kg not mg. FDA Carbaglu label uses mg/kg dosing (100-250 mg/kg/day). Cmax 8.6 matches ~100mg/kg in pediatric patients. Flag as uncertain.

cefpodoxime.notes: PRODRUG: cefpodoxime proxetil (ester prodrug → cefpodoxime active). FDA Vantin: 200mg Cmax=2.2 µg/mL. Dose fixed 100→200mg. Reference measures active cefpodoxime.

cetirizine.notes: Fixed: dose was 60mg. FDA Zyrtec label: 10mg Cmax=311 ng/mL=0.311 mg/L (exact match). Dose error 10→60mg.

ciprofloxacin.notes: Fixed: dose was 50mg (likely 10x extraction error). Cmax=2.97 mg/L matches ciprofloxacin 500mg IR from FDA label.

darifenacin.notes: Fixed: dose was 400mg (impossible — max clinical dose is 15mg). Cmax=0.0112 matches ~15mg ER. FDA Enablex label: 15mg Cmax=3.4 ng/mL=0.0034 mg/L. Our ref 0.0112 is plausible for 15mg IR or higher dose study.

darolutamide.notes: Fixed: Cmax was 4.79 (fed data from FDA Nubeqa). Darolutamide Cmax is 2-2.5x higher with food. Fasted Cmax ≈ 2.2 µg/mL estimated from food effect ratio.

darunavir ethanolate.notes: DDI-BOOSTED: Cmax 7.32 mg/L from ritonavir-boosted steady-state (Prezista 600mg + ritonavir 100mg BID). Dose=100mg is error (possibly from 100mg/mL suspension concentration). Pipeline predicts unboosted single-drug PK.

diclofenac.source_id: FDA label diclofenac sodium DR tablets
diclofenac.notes: FIXED 2026-03-22: Cmax was 0.024 (unit error). FDA label: ~1.0 mcg/mL for 25mg delayed-release tablet.

ketorolac.notes: Fixed: Cmax 2.52 matches ketorolac 30mg (FDA Toradol: 30mg oral Cmax≈2.4 µg/mL). Was labeled as 10mg.

lenacapavir.notes: FIXED 2026-03-22: Was 927mg SubQ dose (Cmax 0.0738). Corrected to 600mg oral loading (2x300mg tablets). Cmax ~101.4 ng/mL from Sunlenca FDA label. Low oral F (6-10%).

lopinavir.notes: DDI-BOOSTED: Cmax 9.8 mg/L is from Kaletra (lopinavir 400mg + ritonavir 100mg) steady-state. Unboosted lopinavir has ~1/10 exposure. Never used without ritonavir clinically. Dose also wrong (200 vs 400mg in label). Pipeline predicts unboosted single-drug PK.

molnupiravir.notes: PRODRUG: molnupiravir → NHC (beta-D-N4-hydroxycytidine). FDA Lagevrio measures NHC metabolite Cmax. Pipeline predicts parent ester.

naproxen.notes: Fixed: Cmax was 95.2 (high end, likely naproxen sodium or fed). Adjusted to 70.0 mg/L (median fasted literature for 500mg naproxen base).

posaconazole.notes: FIXED 2026-03-22: Cmax was 0.014 (extraction error). Correct: 893 ng/mL fasted, DR tablet 300mg single dose (PMC4432131 Fang 2015).

primaquine.notes: Fixed from 0.001 (extraction artifact). 30mg oral single dose, fasted.

sertraline.notes: Fixed: Cmax was 0.165 (matches 150-200mg, not 50mg). FDA Zoloft label: 50mg single dose Cmax~33 ng/mL=0.033 mg/L.

valacyclovir.notes: PRODRUG: valacyclovir→acyclovir. Cmax=14.4 is for acyclovir after 1g valacyclovir (FDA Valtrex label). Dose fixed 20→1000mg. Pipeline predicts parent, not metabolite.

valganciclovir.notes: FIXED 2026-03-22: Cmax was 58.0 (decimal error, 10x too high). Correct: ganciclovir Cmax 5.61 mcg/mL after 900mg valganciclovir oral with food (PMID 10496303). PRODRUG: valganciclovir→ganciclovir. Pipeline predicts parent.

venlafaxine.notes: Fixed: Cmax was 0.0055 (extraction error). Correct: 0.150 mg/L (150 ng/mL) from Effexor IR 75mg FDA label.

metoclopramide.notes: Fixed from 0.001 (extraction artifact). Reglan 10mg IR, fasted, healthy.

buspirone.notes: Fixed from 0.001 (extraction artifact). Buspirone F~4% (extensive first-pass).

pindolol.notes: FIXED 2026-03-22: Cmax was 0.167 (upper bound of 4-fold range). FDA label: 45-167 ng/mL for 20mg. Geometric mean sqrt(45*167) = 87 ng/mL = 0.087 mg/L.
